summary: First villa challenge: 'Heartquake' — couples answer questions about each other while standing on a wobble platform over the pool. Rohan's spreadsheet fails him; Sienna dares him into the best answer of the day. Greta and Matteo accidentally win everything, to their mutual horror and delight.
continuityNotes: Sienna's ep2 teasing of Rohan escalates into the challenge dare.
